name: ls-profile-pair
cmd: set -o pipefail; grep -m1 'model name' /proc/cpuinfo; mkdir -p base && tar -xf baselines/base.tar -C base && (cp -R vendor/. base/vendor/ 2>/dev/null || true) && bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && (cd base && bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null) && for side in mine base; do d=.; [ $side = base ] && d=base; echo "SIDE $side"; (cd $d && mkdir -p prof && GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 900 bun --cpu-prof --cpu-prof-md --cpu-prof-dir=prof --cpu-prof-interval=4000 research/track-gen/t13-generation.ts learning_switch 2>&1 >/dev/null | grep -v T13_DATA | grep '"phases"\|join small\|small instance\|sample' | cut -c1-300; echo PROFILE; f=$(ls prof/*.md | head -1); grep -m1 'Top 10' "$f"; grep '^| *[0-9.]*% |' "$f" | head -28); done
